description: South Korea housing subscription points (cheongyak gajeom, max 84) for private apartment sales: homeless period (max 32), dependents (max 35) and subscription account period (max 17). The spouse-account bonus is not included.

accountYears.description: Years since the subscription savings account was opened

dependents.description: Dependents in the household, excluding the applicant

homelessYears.description: Years without a home, counted from age 30 or from marriage registration if earlier

ownsHome.description: Applicant or spouse owns a home (homeless-period points become 0); default false
